body:
### Summary

This is a quirky one, and unfortunately is a known issue and expected behavior as stated by the dotenvy crate maintainer.

I encountered this recently, and finally tracked it down. I am opening this issue here because I don't believe the issue is clearly documented, and partially because there have not been any release for dotenvy since March of 2023, more than 3.5 years. 

Behaviour | dotenvy issue | State
-- | -- | --
A $ in a value cuts it short or fails, silently | #93 "silently fails to parse strings with dollar signs" | Closed, as intended behaviour (substitution)
$A_PLAIN read as $A plus _PLAIN | #170 underscore names in substitution | Open
Unquoted value with a space fails | #11 "Unquoted values cannot contain spaces" | Open since 2022
Differs from python-dotenv generally | #19 "Document differences across dotenv implementations" | Open

The primary problems here are that python-dotenv (and other languages) do not have these issues, so migrating to uv with .env cli injection breaks applications that rely on .env for envvars unexpectedly.

I don't think there's a valid reason to move away from dotenvy, but I do think that the issues should be documented. If desired, I am willing to contribute the appropriate documentation updates to note the

title: .env parsing - dotenvy fails to correctly parse files with spaces and some special characters
